snippet.title: ROOM 713 - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
May 1978. After a long drive through the night, you arrive at a lonely hotel. The lobby is empty, but someone has left a tape recorder on the reception counter. A single message plays:  _“Your room is 713.”_

ROOM 713 is an anomaly-spotting, psychological horror game set in the endless, looping corridors of a mysterious, liminal hotel. Spot anomalies to climb floors and reach your room... or be trapped forever.

*Wishlist ROOM 713 on Steam!* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3961890/Room_713/
